verdict.rationale: Composio documents Composio Connect, a hosted MCP server at https://connect.composio.dev/mcp. Developers with an MCP-compatible client can use it without creating an SDK session and reach 1000+ downstream apps through a single connection. Sessions can also expose a hosted MCP URL via `mcp: true` with no provider package, and auth is handled through Connect Links with no auth UI to build. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that pointing a client at the hosted URL works end-to-end.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point my MCP-compatible client at a hosted remote server URL and reach downstream tools without deploying any infrastructure

citations.quote: Composio Connect is an MCP server at https://connect.composio.dev/mcp that gives your AI agent access to 1000+ apps, including Gmail, Notion, Slack, GitHub, Linear, HubSpot, and Strava, through a single connection.
Use Composio Connect when you already have an MCP-compatible client and want the shared Composio MCP URL, without creating an SDK session.
Opt into MCP by passing `mcp: true` when you create the session. The session then exposes its hosted MCP server.
Set mcp: true when an MCP transport fits your application better. No provider package is required for this route.
